title: Editing Implicit Assumptions in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus was on editing general implicit assumptions (e.g., the color of an object) and mitigating social biases, specifically gender bias in professions.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of its analysis.
